sources.title: 'We want an elevator': As Kyler Murray and J.J. McCarthy split first-team reps, what will determine Vikings QB battle?
sources.description: Head coach Kevin O'Connell met with each of his quarterbacks as they reported to camp this week to explain his vision and plan for managing snaps and determining who will start Week 1.
